# Education Law Center

> > Education Law Center is a nonprofit legal advocacy organization fighting for education equity and student rights through litigation, policy advocacy, and systemic reform.

Based in New Jersey, the Education Law Center uses strategic litigation (including the landmark Abbott v. Burke case), advocacy campaigns, and legal guidance to advance education equity, school funding reform, and civil rights protections for vulnerable student populations. The organization focuses on systemic issues including school funding disparities, student discipline reform, special education rights, and protections for English learners and immigrant students.

## Key Topics

- Abbott v. Burke
- Education equity
- School funding reform
- Student rights
- Special education (IDEA)
- Anti-bullying legislation
- English learner rights
- Immigrant student protections
- Student discipline reform
- School facilities infrastructure
- Civil rights advocacy
- Litigation advocacy
- New Jersey education law
- Zero-tolerance policy reform
- Student residency rights

## Core Issues & Advocacy Areas

- [School Funding](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/school-funding): School funding reform and Abbott v. Burke litigation for fair education finance.
- [Special Education](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/special-education): Special education and disability rights advocacy with IDEA compliance and systemic litigation.
- [Student Discipline](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/student-discipline): Student discipline reform, zero-tolerance advocacy, and due process rights protection.
- [Bullying Prevention](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/bullying): Anti-bullying legislation, school policy advocacy, and student harassment legal guidance.
- [English Learners](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/english-learners): English learner rights advocacy including language barriers and civil rights protections.
- [Immigrant Students](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/immigrant-students): Immigrant student education rights, school safety, and anti-discrimination advocacy.
- [School Facilities](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/school-facilities): School facilities infrastructure advocacy and Abbott v. Burke litigation for equity.
- [Preschool Equity](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/preschool): Preschool advocacy and Abbott v. Burke litigation for early childhood education equity.
- [Student Residency & Enrollment](https://edlawcenter.org/issues/student-residency): Student residency and enrollment rights for homeless and undocumented students.
